title: Aemeath - Wuthering Waves Player
description:
Wuthering Waves themed interactive music player.
Optimized for 16:9 aspect ratios.

Will probably do more wallpapers like this in the future, but way better.
If you have any suggestions for wallpapers / features, let me know!

─────────────────────────────────────────────
FAQ
─────────────────────────────────────────────

🎵 CUSTOM SONGS

How do I add my own songs?
- Click the cover image → Folder icon → open your music folder → Ctrl+A to select all files → Open
- Supported: .mp3 (audio only) and .webm (video + audio). Other file types are automatically ignored.

Cover image for a custom song?
- Select an image with the exact same filename as the song (e.g. mysong.mp3 + mysong.jpg)

Go back to built-in songs?
- Click the refresh button next to the folder icon

Note: your custom songs reset every time you exit and re-enter the wallpaper. You only need to reselect them when you want to listen to your own songs again.

─────────────────────────────────────────────

🎧 SPOTIFY / SYSTEM MEDIA

Show my currently playing song?
- Settings → enable Spotify / System Now Playing
- Requires Media Integration to be enabled in Wallpaper Engine
- Works with Spotify and other Windows media players

─────────────────────────────────────────────

🌊 VISUALIZER

Visualizer is blurry / glitched?
- Settings → Reload Visualizer
- If still broken: Settings → Theme → switch to any other theme, then switch back

Visualizer is the wrong colour?
- Settings → Theme → switch to any other theme, then switch back

─────────────────────────────────────────────

🖼️ CUSTOM BACKGROUND

How do I use my own wallpaper image?
- Settings → Background → click the User tile
- WE properties panel → Custom BG Image → Select File (.jpg / .png / .jpeg / .webp)

How do I use random backgrounds?
- Settings → Background → click the Random tile
- Choose how often it changes: 1m / 5m / 10m / 15m / 30m

How do I adjust it?
- Settings → Background → Size, X/Y Offset, Mouse Animation (parallax), Brightness, Blur, etc.

─────────────────────────────────────────────

📋 PLAYLIST

Control which songs play when skipping?
- Check/uncheck the checkbox next to each song
- If none are checked, all songs play

Only play favorites?
- Click the heart (♡) on a song to favorite it
- Click the heart filter button at the top of the playlist to only play those

Reorder songs?
- Use the ↑ / ↓ arrows on each playlist item

─────────────────────────────────────────────

📐 LAYOUT & BACKGROUND MODES

Background modes (MV = Music Video):
- MV Full Screen — song MV fills the whole screen
- MV Small Window — floating MV window over your BG image
- Image — static background only

Move / resize things?
- Settings → Layout → X/Y offsets for the player, small MV window, and global
- Also has Mirror Layout and Center Vertically options

─────────────────────────────────────────────

⚙️ SETTINGS

Who made the backgrounds / music?
- Settings → Credit
- Note: it prioritizes background image credits. To see who made an AMV/MV, switch to MV Full Screen — the artist updates when the MV is fullscreened.

Language?
- Bottom right of the Settings panel, under Force Save → EN / JP / CN

My settings don't save!
- Settings → Force Save after setting everything up

Reset everything back to how it was when you downloaded it?
- Settings → Reset Settings → click again to confirm

─────────────────────────────────────────────

I do not own the rights to the wallpapers and/or music used. All credit goes to the original artists. (See the Credit button in the settings!)
If you are the original artist and want a wallpaper removed, contact me.
